name: Moore County, NC
findings: Moore County has 310 nonprofit organizations. 134 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 109 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Moore County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list public events
observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 19 would.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
